purpose.primary: Provide a small formal teaching abstraction for selected dimension-group relationships associated with the Nawderian Theorem.
purpose.formal_goal: Represent explicit group membership and prove only those relationships supported by the supplied definitions.
purpose.educational_principle: Formalization should expose when an informal relationship requires a definition rather than inventing one merely to obtain the desired theorem.
